facts.value: The Department of Economics offers the program 'Economic Chinese' with conceptual support and guidance from the field of Sinology. This program consists of 4 courses, starting with a course for beginners with no prior knowledge. The offerings include levels A1 (Basic Chinese Course) and A2 (Economic Chinese) according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages.
facts.programme_association: German Courses - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: After completing the entire program, students should be able to conduct simple dialogues in Chinese and handle typical everyday situations as well as situations related to tourism and professional/business stays in China independently. They should acquire linguistic and intercultural competencies as well as knowledge about culture and society in China that is beneficial for activities in the area of Chinese-German economic relations and to establish and maintain contacts with Chinese partners.

facts.value: Reading comprehension and writing skills are assessed in the form of a 90-minute examination in the last week of lectures. A graded certificate is issued for successfully passing the examination.

facts.value: A1 according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CERF)
The Basic Chinese Course 1 is required for this module. There is an opportunity to enter the program based on already existing knowledge.
The aim of this course is to acquire the basic subject vocabulary and consolidate the knowledge of the basic structures of the Chinese language.

The language competence will be assessed at the end of the course in the form of a 90-minute examination in the last week of lectures. A graded certificate is issued for successfully passing the examination.
90 Euro
13 double lessons, including final exam
This course takes place only in the summer semester.
Economic Chinese Course 1

facts.value: A2.1 according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CERF)
Linguistic knowledge based on the vocabulary lists of the state-recognized language level test HSK of levels I is required. About 50 characters should be passively recognized for this course.
Economic-related linguistic competencies will be gradually developed.

The language competence will be assessed at the end of the course in the form of a 90-minute examination in the last week of lectures. A graded certificate is issued for successfully passing the examination.
90 Euro
13 double lessons, including final exam
This course takes place only in the winter semester.

facts.value: A2 according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CERF)

Linguistic knowledge based on the vocabulary lists of the state-recognized language level tests HSK of levels I and II are required, and knowledge of characters at HSK level I is necessary. About 100 characters should be passively recognized for this course.
Economic-related linguistic competencies will be gradually developed.

The language competence will be assessed at the end of the course in the form of a 90-minute examination in the last week of lectures. A graded certificate is issued for successfully passing the examination.
